asr.full_text: Now Listen to me carefully Your wife is very... What did i say... Yes, the doctor is here Hello Come in Hey That voice is horrible! I think its a street vendor! It is making a noise! What has to you? You will not understand What??? Whenever we encounter a woman wearing weird clothes What happened? She begins to dance & have sex on my hand What is this? Sorry? This.... I am promoting her where did she go?? It's her Promoting him Whom are you promoting for? What do you mean How dare you? You had any problems? My husband has so much... You have kids? Not yet.... What is difficult about your husband? do you have any kids? no you wont! You will be rich! your man has a problem? my man has problem when he stumbles on the ground stumbles? under the bed or outside? under the bed he is paralysed what is his issue? Analysed your man keeps on stumbling yes you have brought him here for medicines He is not able to stand He does'nt? No You started working on his hands, did you not? Yes Still you didn't start work Again no Did you both start work? Yes Again no Still not Do something What Apply a oil for toilet Where is that possible? You can find anything like that on the streets And if you don't stand because of that You will never be able to make a living Come here Your wedding date has been how much? 3 months You have got married for 3 months now? Yes Since how long have you been in your groom 3 months And when and how long this position has been going on for you? For 1 1 1 month What! Who conditioned your man to live in this situation? Before marriage how many people were in the graveyard in my house? Not even one You half sick, and you are laughing? No Oh no, why he is hanging like that? Hold him But how much are you able to laugh on it ? No Hey, where can i find him ? Go ahead & look Forget ! Forget ! What is this ? Don't pull it Why ? This is the Discovery Channel There are huge animals inside Understood ? Go & find your man Would you like me to say his name ? Ofcourse This must be a lady Can you tell me the address? Can you? It is in front of me. It's a women's room. Tedi pudiya! I'm sleeping here. On my bed, the bed of a doctor can't be seen. And this is at midnight. At midnight? Don't you see her at morning? See the doctor and see what she took. I'm saying these things as a servant. That's what the male doctor does at midnight. Men do it in the morning. You go and take a night medicine. Okay. A night treatment. Bye! Hi! Okay The guy's do it during men's day You go and get him one at night What? Treatment Bye Now come Hey..Doctor You made any advertisement? Yes You can work The advertisement is like this Yes No cure for doctors, no medicine What! The patient will die but the doctor can be on the market for medicines Wow. What a thing medicines for you. What? You will die a person, will always stand on the market only to buy medicines. Wonderful! Do, one thing. What? Pick an Imam & give him medicines for you. Alright. Its so hot in here now! Hey start the fan now There is no light Its good! It's so hot in here, son... Turn that fan on. Why not? I am feeling hot already. It comes to the people's own accord. Turn the power back. Here is my Imam. And there's a Dasta over there, Then? I've to tell you how it works. If you don't listen and are too quiet, I'll kill you, idiot. Turn the light on. STOP IT! When you say more you be hit! Now, I'll take the boot. Turn this off! Oh, it's on. Why are you dancing? Radio is going on, next door. Yeah. I can hear the songs. Really? The weather is great. Really? Tell me something. Whose radio is this? The neighbors. Listen! Who is the singer? A neighbor. How much did my brother-in-law spend? He didn't! So, what is your father going to do? What?? Whose radio is that? Of the neighbours But how is he listening then? Neighbors Then how much money has he spent? Neighbors Then what happened to your dad? Take this Radio belongs to neighbours Yes Cell belongs to the neighbours Yes Money belongs to the neighbours Yes Then what about my father? Just do something What? Just get him the medicines Should we turn off the radio at that spot? I would say it Let the medicines go, nothing is going in Hey, turn off this radio Give a nice smack Turn off the station We will. There is nothing called mass, just a kick Shut the radio So much pain. I'm always in love So much pain. I'm always in love Hey Rajay ji Let me Do you play it or not? Oh dear Do you play it or not? Oh, my God, my God Hey, man You... Get the money Hey, it's been ten days Let's do it for twenty days You will do like that? If I stand like this Oh... Then go. Make my salary. But I just finished my work. Then you perform this for 20 days.. Will you do it like this? Do this.. If you put patience.. ...it will cost you. But why are you dancing? Is TV running by? Yes it is. Do you hear the music? Yes. Enough.. You are making me crazy. What mind did you make up? Before I made.. ..your job I used to dance.. Nautankim.. What with? When Nautankim used to dance. Were at Navchankim, Rambha village Really? Yes Now I feel sorry for you Yeah Tell me Who's TV is this? My neighbour's Now tell me, whom is this? My neighbour's Who costed you money? I did What's wrong with your father? No, that's right Tv is for neighbour's Who are you? Listen, your neighbour? Yes Who is wrong by your father? The real reason behind what happened on his name
